an3.94:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, saradasamaye viddhe vigatavalāhake deve ādicco nabhaṃ abbhussakkamāno sabbaṃ ākāsagataṃ tamagataṃ abhivihacca bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca.
an3.94:2.1: evameva kho bhikkhave, yato ariyasāvakassa virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi. sahadassanuppādā, bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa tīṇi saññojanāni pahīyanti,
an3.94:3.1: athāparaṃ dvīhi dhammehi niyyāti abhijjhāya ca vyāpādena ca.
an3.94:3.2: so vivicceva kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an3.94:3.3: tasmiṃ bhikkhave, samaye ariyasāvako kālaṃ kareyya, natthi taṃ saññojanaṃ, yena saññojanena saññutto ariyasāvako puna imaṃ lokaṃ āgaccheyyāti.
